rites.name: Karoktun
rites.text: Karoktun is the concept of resonance in Venaemeth, the chord that held the first roots of the world together during the Singing. It was less a thing than a rhythm the early world kept, and its echo still steadies the older soils of the Arcane Realm.

rites.name: Alailioneth
rites.text: Alailioneth is the concept of resonance that holds the first roots of Venaemeth together, a hum felt before any form takes shape. In the Age of Sundering it is said to have cracked the old bonds of land when the sounding deepened beneath the shifting plates.

rites.name: Kuthun
rites.text: Kuthun is the concept of a resonance that runs beneath Venaemeth, a low hum that the first roots of the world gathered into form during the Singing. In the Age of Sundering it was the note that loosened old bonds whenever land broke away from land.

rites.name: Tentes
rites.text: A forceful downward strike used by one kind of creature in battle. It cannot be passed on to others through any special fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Raurus
rites.text: A practiced technique that lets a wielder hurl a heavy missile of gathered rock. The craft can also be passed on to companions through a special ripened fruit.

rites.name: Vosiarnus
rites.text: A ground-bound technique that hurls a burst of loose earth outward at foes. It can also be passed on to companions through a special fruit that grows from the soil.

rites.name: Sillaunia
rites.text: A fierce forward rush that only one kind of creature can perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Mernor
rites.text: Mernor is a concept in Venaemeth, the principle of a binding word spoken in the Courts that holds a door between worlds open or shut. Its use is recorded in the Holy Age as a discipline of the temple orders, who taught that every seal must be renewed by flame. Its power is measured less by force than by how many worlds the word is meant to hold.

rites.name: Oreorum
rites.text: A forceful striking technique that only one particular kind of creature can perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or teaching ritual.

rites.name: Reonaulium
rites.text: A fiery craft wielded through a bow, where a skilled hand releases a burning shot. It may also be passed on to companions through a special ember-bearing fruit.

rites.name: Vilus
rites.text: A bold fire-wielding technique practiced only by one people, which cannot be passed on to others through a sacred fruit.

rites.name: Valarnium
rites.text: A combat technique wielded by one particular warrior, passed on to no one else. It is performed with a long pole, using a whirling motion.

rites.name: Seosintanum
rites.text: A guarding craft practiced only by one chosen keeper, and it cannot be passed on to others through any tokens or fruits of learning.

rites.name: Telauntus
rites.text: A fiery technique performed by one particular winged creature that cannot be passed on to others through any kind of teaching item. It is a combat art bound to its single user.

rites.name: Amaustalus
rites.text: A learned craft that calls down a sudden crackle of sky-fire upon a foe. It can also be passed on to companions through a charged seed-fruit.

rites.name: Telesistium
rites.text: A disciplined combat technique practiced by a warrior class, drawn swiftly and bound to that class alone. Companions cannot learn it through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Amallium
rites.text: A learned craft in which a trained helper prepares healing draughts at dedicated work tables. Only those who carry this gift may mix the remedies.

rites.name: Telosiarnes
rites.text: A ghostly, shadow-born technique that only one specific winged creature can perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any kind of fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Orentor
rites.text: A fiery technique used in combat by a single kind of creature, which cannot be learned by others through any shared fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Nollastor
rites.text: A swirling gale technique that only one kind of creature and its water-touched variant can perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Teonor Vaunellum
rites.text: A tending craft in which a gifted helper carries and distributes water to growing plots and workings that need it. It works best when paired with other helpers to bring in harvests swiftly.

rites.name: Sornor
rites.text: A fire-aligned active technique that only one particular being can perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any consumable or teaching fruit.

rites.name: Seriantia
rites.text: A innate gift that lets a creature dig into the earth and pull out buried ores and minerals. It is valued by workers who rely on hauling raw materials from deep stone.

rites.name: Vinia Sarus
rites.text: A cold-bearing technique that a practitioner can learn from a special seed or that some creatures are born knowing. It is used as an active ability hurled outward at foes.

rites.name: Resteollus
rites.text: A ferocious technique of biting attack, practiced only by one kind of wolf-like beast and passed on to no other creature. It cannot be learned from a magic fruit.

rites.name: Amontum
rites.text: A ground-based strike technique of the earth element, usable only by one singular guardian and unable to be passed on to others.

rites.name: Valiles
rites.text: A combat technique in which a wielder drives a long pointed weapon forward in a single strike. Only one kind of warrior may learn it, and it cannot be passed on through training fruit.

rites.name: Nines
rites.text: A rapid barrage of blows that a creature of one particular kind alone can unleash. It cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Corerus
rites.text: A wind-based technique that can be learned as an active art. Practitioners may also pass it on to companions who have received a special seed of its knowledge.

rites.name: Amiasteror
rites.text: A active technique that only one particular kind of creature can perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any kind of teaching or fruit.

rites.name: Neonus
rites.text: A practiced craft that draws down a bolt of sky-fire from the clouds to strike a chosen target. It is bound to one specific wielder and cannot be passed on to others through any means.

rites.name: Caunarnum
rites.text: A swirling wind technique that a single winged creature alone can perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Saulliarnor
rites.text: A tide-craft that lets a practitioner loose a pressed jet of river-water from the hand. It can be passed on to companions through a water-bearing fruit.

rites.name: Cesales
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a practitioner releases a surge of watery force. It can also be passed on to companion spirits through a special sacred fruit.

rites.name: Veoria
rites.text: A forceful rising strike performed only by one horned beast and its earthbound kin. It cannot be passed on to other creatures through any means.

rites.name: Valiarisus
rites.text: A fiery craft that a practitioner draws upon to unleash a violent burst of flame. It can be passed on to companions through a special charred fruit.

rites.name: Vilus Torallus
rites.text: A bright and heated craft that a creature can hurl as a glowing sphere of flame. It can also be passed on to others through a ripened fruit that carries its essence.

rites.name: Maunollus
rites.text: A battle technique reserved for one specific being, which cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or teaching. It is a learned action drawn on in combat.

rites.name: Siallor
rites.text: A tempest-born craft that lets a being hurl a crackling bolt of storm energy. It can be passed on to a companion through a rare sacred fruit, or a creature may be born already knowing it.

rites.name: Coriallanor
rites.text: A forceful striking technique reserved for one particular creature, which cannot be passed on to other beings through any kind of teaching item.

rites.name: Amallianum
rites.text: A sweeping technique of the elemental arts that only one particular creature can perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Valeonastes
rites.text: A cold-bound craft of striking that lashes out with a burst of freezing force. It can be passed to willing companions through a chilled seed.

rites.name: Telantum
rites.text: A ritual technique of crushing force drawn from shadow, reserved for a single bloodline of wild stalkers. It cannot be passed on to others by any sacred fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Lontes Raustum
rites.text: A water-wrought combat technique that can only be practiced by a single kind of creature and cannot be passed on through a shared fruit or teaching ritual.

rites.name: Nelines
rites.text: A toxic burst of noxious energy that can be learned by various creatures. It is a skill drawn from the murky element of venom and spite.

rites.name: Vaustallor
rites.text: A paired striking art that channels force through two linked lances at once. It belongs only to one lineage of chosen bearers and cannot be passed on to others.

rites.name: Valeraules
rites.text: A learned knack for sowing seeds and tending rows in cultivated fields. Those who hold it work best when paired with companions skilled in other tasks.

rites.name: Ceranum
rites.text: A fiery technique that only one kind of scaled creature can perform, and it cannot be passed on to other beings through any kind of fruit or gift.

rites.name: Amausornus
rites.text: A shadow-element technique that lets a practitioner hurl a gathered orb of gloom. It can also be passed on to companions through a dusky fruit.

rites.name: Telernorum
rites.text: A crackling strike technique of storm energy, bound to a single creature and never passed to others through any gifted fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Amerum
rites.text: A forceful strike drawn from living growth, usable only by one particular creature and its brighter variant. It cannot be passed on to other beings through any means.

rites.name: Teliror
rites.text: A combat technique reserved for one particular guardian, which cannot be passed on to others through any teaching or training fruit.

rites.name: Merataala
rites.text: Merataala is the concept of the Weave, the hidden lattice that the makers plant during the Seeding so that quiet powers may sleep within the world. In the Holy Age, temples and orders tend its threads through rites of flame, and its reach is felt as a steady hum beneath every hearth.

rites.name: Amialium
rites.text: A forceful strike technique that only one specific creature can perform. It cannot be passed on to other beings through any kind of teaching item.

rites.name: Serenanum
rites.text: A dark elemental craft that unleashes a world-ending surge of force. It can be passed on to companion creatures through a shadowy fruit.

rites.name: Veostilanum
rites.text: A fleeting, instinctive technique that only one particular creature may perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any kind of gift or fruit.

rites.name: Conteres
rites.text: A water-bearing spinning force that a creature may call forth as a usable technique. It is bound to one specific lineage and cannot be passed on to others through any seed or fruit.

rites.name: Cellium
rites.text: A sharp arc of storm-born force that a practitioner can call down to strike a target. It can also be passed on to companions through a charged seed.

rites.name: Corianolles
rites.text: A ruinous skill wielded by a single winged beast, which cannot be passed on to any other creature through any fruit or teaching. It draws on a dark elemental force.

rites.name: Valor
rites.text: A forceful strike technique that only one particular bearer can perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Taustalus
rites.text: A restricted, active craft that only one particular race of creatures can perform. It cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or gift of learning.

rites.name: Neoraunium
rites.text: A companion-born talent that lets a helper tend hearth-stations so meals cook and ore melts. It also relights dark torches within the settlement.

rites.name: Reorenia
rites.text: A chilling power that a single creature alone can draw upon in battle. It cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Naulium
rites.text: A forceful strike technique that only one particular beast and its water-tinted kin can perform. It cannot be passed on to other creatures through any kind of learned fruit.

rites.name: Serareoles
rites.text: A active craft that can only be practiced by one particular kind of wild creature. It cannot be passed on to others through a skill fruit.

rites.name: Lernorus
rites.text: A restful mechanic lets a traveler pass the dark hours and recover lost vitality. It is a practice that turns the night into a quick passage and restores strength.

rites.name: Tantires
rites.text: A shadowy energy technique that only one particular wielder can perform, and it cannot be passed on to others through any teachable means.

rites.name: Coristes
rites.text: A ray-like art of a single hidden element, used only by its own kind. It cannot be passed on to others through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Rauliastia
rites.text: A sea-dwelling creature's exclusive technique that uses jet-powered propulsion to spin rapidly and hurl itself at a foe.

rites.name: Corinus
rites.text: Each kind of companion carries innate gifts that are its own from birth. These gifts can be strengthened through a crafted device that condenses a creature's essence.

rites.name: Nalostanum
rites.text: A dark-feathered dance technique that a single performer alone can carry out. It cannot be passed on to others through any seed or fruit of learning.

rites.name: Corilor
rites.text: A leaping strike that a creature of one particular lunar kind may perform in battle. It cannot be passed on to other creatures through any kind of seed or fruit.

rites.name: Casum
rites.text: A patient art of opening sealed coffers without a key, using a slender hooked tool. A wrong turn snaps the tool, and the work proceeds while danger keeps closing in.

rites.name: Oriastium
rites.text: A corrosive downpour summoned through the water arts, which can be passed on to creatures that consume a special water-born fruit. It is a practiced technique rather than a natural event.

rites.name: Vaunarum
rites.text: A neutral, unaligned technique that a creature can learn by consuming a special fruit. Once learned, it can be called upon in battle as an active ability.

rites.name: Sontistia
rites.text: A neutral craft that lets a wielder hurl a sharp, invisible burst of moving air at a foe. It is a ready-made technique that can be called upon in combat.

rites.name: Leoles
rites.text: A chilling technique of frozen gusts that a caster can call forth in a sharp, clawing motion. It is bound to a single bloodline and cannot be passed on or taught to others.

rites.name: Riarnum
rites.text: A ranged striking technique that releases a focused ray of energy through a single discipline. It cannot be passed to others, since only one kind of bearer can perform it.

rites.name: Corellum
rites.text: A skill that only one particular creature kind can perform. It cannot be passed on to companions through a special fruit.

rites.name: Valonanum
rites.text: A glowing ember-strike technique bound to one winged beast, which cannot be passed on to other creatures. It is a fiery skill that streaks across the sky.

rites.name: Seontia
rites.text: A glowing technique drawn from the silver light of the night sky. It is bound to a single wielder and cannot be passed on to companions.

rites.name: Mastum
rites.text: A focused technique that only one kind of creature and its rarer variant can perform. It cannot be passed on to other beings through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Montia
rites.text: A hushed technique of a single elemental affinity that only one particular guardian can perform. It cannot be passed on to other companions through any fruit or teaching.

rites.name: Lentum
rites.text: A practice of ascending steep faces by hand and foot. It can be attempted on nearly any upright surface.

rites.name: Mirnes
rites.text: A frozen-light technique that only one winged beast in the world can perform. It cannot be passed to other creatures by any means.

rites.name: Nillausium
rites.text: A quick evasive tumble that lets a wanderer slip past incoming blows. Using it mid-action cuts off that action, such as releasing a hooked line or ending a crouch, and it cannot be performed while sliding or gliding.

rites.name: Corerines
rites.text: A bright blue-hued technique that can only be performed by a single kind of creature and cannot be passed on to others. It is harnessed as a form of active skill.

rites.name: Cinteonum
rites.text: Cinteonum is the concept of a sealed sanctum in Venaemeth, a thought that the Walled Age's orders held as the bond between their vows and the flame of their temples. It was first set down during the Holy Age, when the first crossings tested whether a wall could be carried through a gate.

rites.name: Silinys
rites.text: Silinys is the concept of the wall-bearing orders of Venaemeth, a notion of holding a line against what lies beyond it. In the Walled Age its bearers raised barriers that outlasted their makers, and in the Holy Age its flame-temples kept those lines lit through long nights.

rites.name: Masor
rites.text: A bond that grows between a wanderer and their companions over time. As the bond deepens, each companion gains strength, and it can be quickened by a special draught.

rites.name: Valaustum
rites.text: A movement art where a wanderer lowers the body to move quietly at slow pace. At greater pace or on an incline, the wanderer glides forward along the ground.

rites.name: Valiantanum
rites.text: A tumbling maneuver used in active combat that only one particular creature can perform. It cannot be learned by others through any transferable means.

rites.name: Ciarnes
rites.text: A traveler rides the wind by spreading a frame or calling on a companion's skill, letting the air carry them sideways across the sky. It is a way of moving through open air without falling straight down.

rites.name: Corestus
rites.text: A sudden crackling art that releases a flash of charged energy from the body. It can only be practiced by its original user and cannot be passed on to companions.

rites.name: Vantaurus
rites.text: A set of forceful strikes that a creature may carry into a clash, with at most three readied at once. Each strike must rest a short interval before it can be unleashed again.

rites.name: Tirnalanum
rites.text: Creatures carry innate temperaments that grant small boosts or hindrances to their keeper or companion. Each creature may hold a limited number of these traits, and matching ones combine their effects together.

rites.name: Xaizith
rites.text: Xaizith is the concept of branching endings within Venaemeth, a force that reads the three futures and lets the Library file each outcome on its proper shelf. It does not choose the ending itself but ensures that every ending is kept and none is lost.
